# Cohousy — Complete Site Content

> Cohousy is a co-living, PG (paying guest) and managed-rental operator in Kharadi, Pune, Maharashtra, India. We house IT and corporate professionals within a 5–10 minute walk of Eon IT Park, World Trade Center Kharadi and Gera Commerzone, and we manage residential property end-to-end for owners and NRIs. Rooms start at ₹10,000/month, all-inclusive, with zero brokerage.

This file contains the full content of www.cohousy.com in plain Markdown: every page, all room types and prices, and 76 frequently asked questions with answers.

Last updated: 2026-08-01
Currency: Indian Rupees (INR, ₹). All prices are per month unless stated otherwise.

---

## Quick Answers

**What is Cohousy?** Cohousy is a co-living and PG accommodation provider in Kharadi, Pune, that also offers end-to-end property management for homeowners and NRIs. It operates four properties in Kharadi and serves professionals working in the Kharadi IT corridor.

**Where is Cohousy located?** Kharadi, Pune, Maharashtra 411014, India. All properties are within 5–10 minutes' walk of Eon IT Park and within 3 km of World Trade Center Kharadi.

**How much does it cost to stay at Cohousy?** From ₹10,000/month for twin-sharing PG to ₹26,000/month for an executive 1BHK. Single-occupancy PG is ₹18,000/month. Short stays start at ₹1,200/night. Every price is all-inclusive.

**Is there a brokerage fee?** No. Cohousy charges zero brokerage on all accommodation.

**What is included in the rent?** Everything: high-speed Wi-Fi, electricity, water, housekeeping, power backup, gym access, 24/7 security, maintenance, and app support. There are no hidden charges and no separate utility bills.

**Does Cohousy have women-only accommodation?** Yes. The Ladies PG in Kharadi is 100% female — all residents are women, with female staff, biometric access, panic buttons and ladies-only gym hours.

**How do I book?** Download the Cohousy app, complete digital KYC (about 30 seconds), browse rooms with virtual tours, and book instantly. The process is paperless and takes under 5 minutes. Or call +91 8908903900.

**Does Cohousy manage property for owners?** Yes. Standard management is 8–10% of monthly rent; the Premium Assured Plan, which guarantees rent even if a tenant defaults, is 12–15%. NRI owners are a core customer segment.

## Ladies PG in Kharadi Pune

Cohousy's ladies PG in Kharadi is a 100% women-only accommodation — every resident is female, staff are trained for women's specific needs, and security personnel are on site including during night shifts. It is designed for women professionals working in the Kharadi IT corridor who want safety, privacy and community.

Safety features specific to women: 24/7 CCTV surveillance, security guards, biometric access control, panic buttons in rooms, family location sharing through the app, direct connection to the women's helpline, and background verification of all residents.

Women-specific services: ladies-only gym hours, women's wellness sessions, health consultations, period care products, professional networking events for women, career mentorship programmes, and 24/7 support through a female property captain.

### Ladies PG FAQs

**Is this a completely women-only PG accommodation?**
Yes, absolutely! Cohousy's ladies PG in Kharadi is exclusively designed for women. All residents are female, and we have security personnel, especially during night shifts. Our staff is trained to understand and address women's specific needs and concerns.

**What safety measures do you have specifically for women?**
We have comprehensive women-focused safety features including 24/7 CCTV surveillance, security guards, biometric access control, panic buttons in rooms, family location sharing through our app, direct connection to women's helpline, and thorough background verification of all residents.

**Do you have single room options available for women?**
Yes! We offer both shared (twin sharing) and single room options. Single rooms come with attached washrooms, balconies, and premium furnishing. This is perfect for professional women who value privacy while still enjoying the community benefits.

**Can my family visit and stay overnight?**
Yes, we welcome family visits and have guest accommodation arrangements. We have a proper visitor management system with advance notification requirements. Female family members can stay overnight with prior approval, and we provide comfortable guest facilities.

**What is your policy for visitors and male guests?**
Male visitors are allowed in designated common areas during specific hours (typically 10 AM to 8 PM) with proper registration and resident accompaniment. They are not permitted in room areas to maintain the women-only environment. All visitors undergo mandatory verification.

**Do you provide any women-specific services or amenities?**
Absolutely! We offer ladies-only gym hours, women's wellness sessions, health consultations, period care products, professional networking events for women, career mentorship programs, and 24/7 support through our female property captain.

**How do you handle emergencies, especially for women's health?**
We have trained female staff for women's health emergencies, direct partnerships with nearby hospitals, women-specific first aid supplies, 24/7 medical helpline access, and our app includes emergency features like panic button and family notification system.

**What makes your ladies PG different from other women's accommodations?**
We focus exclusively on women's needs with 100% female environment, advanced safety technology, women-centric app features, professional networking opportunities, wellness programs, transparent pricing, and a supportive community that empowers women to thrive professionally.

## Long-Term Rentals in Kharadi

Cohousy long-term rentals are private 1RK and 1BHK units with a minimum stay of 3 months, priced from ₹18,000 to ₹26,000/month. The security deposit is waived entirely for stays of 6 months or longer. Discounts increase at 6-month and 12-month commitments, with the best rates on annual stays.

### Long-Term Rental Pricing

| Plan | Type | Price | Was | You save |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Essential Long-term | 1RK private room | ₹18,000/month | ₹21,000 | ₹3,000/month |
| Premium Long-term | 1BHK private room | ₹21,000/month | ₹25,000 | ₹4,000/month |
| Executive Long-term | 1BHK deluxe | ₹26,000/month | ₹30,000 | ₹4,000/month |

### Long-Term Rental FAQs

**What is the minimum stay duration for long-term rentals?**
Our long-term rentals require a minimum stay of 3 months. We offer increasing discounts for 6-month and 12-month commitments, with the best rates available for annual stays.

**Is there a security deposit required?**
For stays of 6 months or longer, we waive the security deposit. For 3-6 month stays, a refundable deposit equivalent to one month's rent is required, which is fully refunded upon checkout.

**Can I extend my stay or transfer to another property?**
Absolutely! Long-term residents have priority for extensions and can transfer to any other Cohousy property within the network without additional charges, subject to availability.

**What happens if I need to terminate early?**
We understand plans change. Early termination is allowed with 30 days notice. A nominal processing fee may apply, but we prioritize flexibility for our long-term residents.

**Are utilities and internet included in the rent?**
Yes, all utilities including electricity, water, high-speed Wi-Fi, and maintenance are included. Long-term residents also get access to premium internet plans and priority support.

**Can I customize my room for long-term stays?**
Yes! Long-term residents can make reasonable customizations like rearranging furniture, adding personal decor, and requesting specific room features. Our team will work with you to make it feel like home.

**What about guest accommodation?**
Long-term residents can host guests with prior approval. We also provide arrangements for visiting family/friends at discounted rates through our guest accommodation program.

**Do you provide any storage solutions?**
Yes, long-term residents get additional storage space for personal belongings, seasonal items, and work equipment. This is included in premium and executive plans.

## Short-Term Rentals in Kharadi

Cohousy short-term rentals have no minimum stay — you can book for a single night. Rates are ₹1,500/night for daily stays, ₹1,300/night for weekly, and ₹1,200/night for monthly, which works out to roughly ₹21,000, ₹17,500 and ₹9,100 respectively as monthly equivalents. There is no lock-in period.

Every stay includes fully furnished accommodation, high-speed Wi-Fi, housekeeping, power backup, security, and access to all amenities including gym and common areas.

### Short-Term Rental FAQs

**What is the minimum stay duration for short-term rentals?**
There is no minimum stay requirement! You can book for as little as one night. However, we offer better rates for weekly and monthly stays to help you save more on extended visits.

**Can I book same-day accommodation?**
Yes! Subject to availability, we offer same-day bookings. You can check availability and book through our app or by calling our 24/7 support team. We recommend booking in advance during peak seasons.

**What is included in the short-term rental price?**
Everything! Your stay includes fully furnished accommodation, high-speed Wi-Fi, housekeeping, power backup, security, and access to all amenities like gym and common areas.

**Is there a cancellation policy?**
Yes, we have a flexible cancellation policy. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in for stays under 7 days, and 48 hours for longer stays. Emergency cancellations are handled on a case-by-case basis.

**Can I extend my stay if needed?**
Absolutely! You can extend your stay through our app or by contacting support, subject to room availability. Extended stays automatically qualify for better weekly or monthly rates.

**Do you provide transportation from airport/railway station?**
We can arrange transportation on request for an additional fee. We also provide detailed directions and nearby public transport options to help you reach our properties easily.

**Can I have guests visit during my short-term stay?**
Yes, guests are allowed with prior notification to security. Overnight guests may require approval and could incur additional charges depending on the duration of their stay.

**What happens if I need to check out early?**
Early check-out is allowed with 24 hours notice. Refunds for unused nights are processed according to our cancellation policy. We try to be as flexible as possible for genuine emergencies.

## Property Management in Pune — For Owners and NRIs

Cohousy manages residential property end-to-end for owners who are not in the city: tenant sourcing, screening, lease, rent collection, maintenance, taxes, monthly reports, and a single point of contact. The positioning is "Your home. Looked after. Always. Owned by you. Lived in beautifully. Earning every month."

The difference from a broker: a broker finds a tenant once and disappears. Cohousy manages the home for the duration — the tenant, the rent, the maintenance, the paperwork and the taxes.

Tenants are sourced through Cohousy's existing co-living network, direct channels and partner referrals, not broker boards. Cohousy pushes for 24–36 month leases with annual rent escalations, and explicitly does not recommend the standard 11-month cycle, which it regards as bad for owners.

### Property Management FAQs

**What does Cohousy Property Management actually cover?**
End-to-end: tenant sourcing, screening, lease, rent collection, maintenance, taxes, monthly reports, and a single point of contact.

**How is this different from using a broker?**
A broker finds a tenant once and disappears. We manage the home for the duration — the tenant, the rent, the maintenance, the paperwork, and the taxes.

**What if my tenant stops paying?**
We handle the chase, the notice period, and (if it gets there) the legal escalation. Our verification is designed to make this rare.

**Do you handle GST and TDS?**
Yes. Where the tenant is a corporate, we structure the lease so you can claim back the 12% GST. We coordinate with your CA on TDS.

**I live abroad or outside Pune. Can you still manage my property?**
Yes. Most of our owners aren't in the city. NRI-friendly documentation and a dashboard you can check from anywhere.

**What happens at move-out?**
Inspection report with photos. Damage assessed against the move-in record. Deposit returned cleanly. Zero disputes is the goal.

**How do you find tenants?**
Through our existing co-living network, direct channels, and partner referrals. We don't depend on broker boards.

**What's the typical lease length?**
We push for longer leases (24–36 months) with annual rent escalations. The 11-month cycle is bad for owners; we don't recommend it.

**How do I get started?**
One call. We'll walk through your property, the market, and what we'd handle. No obligation.

## Owner Services and Pricing

Cohousy's property management for owners and NRIs is priced as a percentage of monthly rent for tenanted properties, and as a flat fee for vacant properties and tax support. Vendor costs are passed through without markup, and any expense above a defined approval threshold requires the owner's explicit approval first.

### Services Pricing

| Service | Price | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Property Management | 8–10% of monthly rent | Comprehensive property management for occupied properties |
| Premium Assured Plan | 12–15% of monthly rent | Everything in Standard, plus guaranteed rent and priority service |
| Vacant Home Care | ₹1,500–₹3,000 per month | For empty properties needing regular care |
| NRI Tax Concierge | ₹12,000–₹30,000 per year | CA partner-led tax and repatriation support for NRI owners |

### Services FAQs

**Will I be updated regularly, even if I live abroad?**
Absolutely. Inspection photo/video reports, monthly statements, and a structured support flow are built into our service model. We understand time zone challenges and ensure communication happens at times convenient for you.

**Do you handle tenant screening and police verification steps?**
Yes, tenant screening and verification are core parts of our tenant management process. We conduct ID verification, income/employer checks, background verification, and coordinate with local authorities for proper documentation.

**What if a repair cost is high?**
We maintain complete transparency with billing. All vendor costs are passed through without markup, and we have approval thresholds in place. Any expense above the defined limit requires your explicit approval before we proceed.

**Do you help with rent increases and renewals?**
Yes, we actively manage renewals and negotiations. We provide data-backed rent increase recommendations based on market analysis, handle tenant discussions, and ensure smooth agreement renewals or new tenant placement.

**Can you guarantee rent?**
Yes, through our Premium Assured Plan / Rent Assurance add-on. Even if rent gets delayed or a tenant defaults, Cohousy pays you on time—ensuring your income stays predictable and passive.
